verses.en: The vision of Isaiah the son of Amoz, which he saw concerning Judah and Jerusalem in the days of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah.
verses.pt: Visão de Isaías, filho de Amoz, a qual ele viu sobre Judá e Jerusalém, nos dias de Uzias, Jotão, Acaz e Ezequias, reis de Judá.
verses.en_web: The vision of Isaiah the son of Amoz, which he saw concerning Judah and Jerusalem, in the days of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah.
verses.en_bbe: The vision of Isaiah, the son of Amoz, which he saw about Judah and Jerusalem, in the days of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah.

verses.en: Hear, O heavens, and give ear, O earth: for the LORD hath spoken, I have nourished and brought up children, and they have rebelled against me.
verses.pt: Ouvi, ó céus; e escutai tu, terra, porque o SENHOR está falando: Eu criei filhos, e os fiz crescerem; porém eles se rebelaram contra mim.
verses.en_web: Hear, heavens, and listen, earth; for Yahweh has spoken: “I have nourished and brought up children, and they have rebelled against me.
verses.en_bbe: Give ear, O heavens, and you, O earth, to the word which the Lord has said: I have taken care of my children till they became men, but their hearts have been turned away from me.

verses.en: The ox knoweth his owner, and the ass his master’s crib: but Israel doth not know, my people doth not consider.
verses.pt: O boi conhece a seu dono, e o jumento sabe a manjedoura de seu possuidor; mas Israel não conhece, meu povo não entende.
verses.en_web: The ox knows his owner, and the donkey his master’s crib; but Israel doesn’t know, my people don’t consider.”
verses.en_bbe: Even the ox has knowledge of its owner, and the ass of the place where its master puts its food: but Israel has no knowledge, my people give no thought to me.

verses.en: Ah sinful nation, a people laden with iniquity, a seed of evildoers, children that are corrupters: they have forsaken the LORD, they have provoked the Holy One of Israel unto anger, they are gone away backward.
verses.pt: Ai da nação pecadora, do povo cheio de perversidade, semente de malfeitores, de filhos corruptos! Abandonaram ao SENHOR, provocaram a ira ao Santo de Israel, dele se afastaram.
verses.en_web: Ah sinful nation, a people loaded with iniquity, offspring of evildoers, children who deal corruptly! They have forsaken Yahweh. They have despised the Holy One of Israel. They are estranged and backward.
verses.en_bbe: O nation full of sin, a people weighted down with crime, a generation of evil-doers, false-hearted children: they have gone away from the Lord, they have no respect for the Holy One of Israel, their hearts are turned back from him.

verses.en: Why should ye be stricken any more? ye will revolt more and more: the whole head is sick, and the whole heart faint.
verses.pt: Para que seríeis espancados ainda mais? Vós vos rebelaríeis mais ainda. Toda a cabeça está enferma, e todo o coração fraco.
verses.en_web: Why should you be beaten more, that you revolt more and more? The whole head is sick, and the whole heart faint.
verses.en_bbe: Why will you have more and more punishment? why keep on in your evil ways? Every head is tired and every heart is feeble.

verses.en: From the sole of the foot even unto the head there is no soundness in it; but wounds, and bruises, and putrifying sores: they have not been closed, neither bound up, neither mollified with ointment.
verses.pt: Desde a planta do pé até a cabeça, não há nele coisa sã. Só há feridas, inchaços e chagas podres, sem terem sido espremidas, feito curativos ou aliviadas com azeite.
verses.en_web: From the sole of the foot even to the head there is no soundness in it: wounds, welts, and open sores. They haven’t been closed, neither bandaged, neither soothed with oil.
verses.en_bbe: The body, from head to foot, is all diseased; it is a mass of open wounds, marks of blows, and broken flesh: the flow of blood has not been stopped, and no oil has been put on the wounds.

verses.en: Your country is desolate, your cities are burned with fire: your land, strangers devour it in your presence, and it is desolate, as overthrown by strangers.
verses.pt: Vossa terra é uma ruína; vossas cidades foram queimadas; vossa terra os estranhos devastaram diante de vossa presença, e está arruinada como que destruída por estranhos.
verses.en_web: Your country is desolate. Your cities are burned with fire. Strangers devour your land in your presence, and it is desolate, as overthrown by strangers.
verses.en_bbe: Your country has become waste; your towns are burned with fire; as for your land, it is overturned before your eyes, made waste and overcome by men from strange lands.

verses.en: And the daughter of Zion is left as a cottage in a vineyard, as a lodge in a garden of cucumbers, as a besieged city.
verses.pt: E a filha de Sião ficou como uma cabana na vinha, como um barraco no pepinal, como uma cidade cercada.
verses.en_web: The daughter of Zion is left like a shelter in a vineyard, like a hut in a field of melons, like a besieged city.
verses.en_bbe: And the daughter of Zion has become like a tent in a vine-garden, like a watchman's house in a field of fruit, like a town shut in by armies.

verses.en: Except the LORD of hosts had left unto us a very small remnant, we should have been as Sodom, and we should have been like unto Gomorrah.
verses.pt: Se o SENHOR dos exércitos não tivesse nos deixado alguns sobreviventes, teríamos sido como Sodoma, seríamos semelhantes aos de Gomorra.
verses.en_web: Unless Yahweh of Armies had left to us a very small remnant, we would have been as Sodom; we would have been like Gomorrah.
verses.en_bbe: If the Lord of armies had not kept some at least of us safe, we would have been like Sodom, and the fate of Gomorrah would have been ours.

verses.en: Hear the word of the LORD, ye rulers of Sodom; give ear unto the law of our God, ye people of Gomorrah.
verses.pt: Ouvi a palavra do SENHOR, vós líderes de Sodoma! Ouvi a Lei do nosso Deus, vós povo de Gomorra!:
verses.en_web: Hear Yahweh’s word, you rulers of Sodom! Listen to the law of our God, you people of Gomorrah!
verses.en_bbe: Give ear to the word of the Lord, you rulers of Sodom; let your hearts be turned to the law of our God, you people of Gomorrah.

verses.en: To what purpose is the multitude of your sacrifices unto me? saith the LORD: I am full of the burnt offerings of rams, and the fat of fed beasts; and I delight not in the blood of bullocks, or of lambs, or of he goats.
verses.pt: Para que me serve tantos sacrifícios vossos?,diz o SENHOR; Já estou farto de sacrifícios de queima de carneiros, e da gordura de animais cevados. Não me alegro com o sangue de bezerros, nem com o de cordeiros ou bodes.
verses.en_web: “What are the multitude of your sacrifices to me?”, says Yahweh. “I have had enough of the burnt offerings of rams, and the fat of fed animals. I don’t delight in the blood of bulls, or of lambs, or of male goats.
verses.en_bbe: What use to me is the number of the offerings which you give me? says the Lord; your burned offerings of sheep, and the best parts of fat cattle, are a weariness to me; I take no pleasure in the blood of oxen, or of lambs, or of he-goats.

verses.en: When ye come to appear before me, who hath required this at your hand, to tread my courts?
verses.pt: Quando vindes a aparecer perante minha face, quem vos pediu isso de vossas mãos, de pisardes em meus pátios?
verses.en_web: When you come to appear before me, who has required this at your hand, to trample my courts?
verses.en_bbe: At whose request do you come before me, making my house unclean with your feet?

verses.en: Bring no more vain oblations; incense is an abomination unto me; the new moons and sabbaths, the calling of assemblies, I cannot away with; it is iniquity, even the solemn meeting.
verses.pt: Não tragais mais ofertas inúteis; vosso incenso para mim é abominação; não aguento mais as luas novas, os sábados, e as chamadas para o povo se reunir; todas estas se tornaram reuniões malignas.
verses.en_web: Bring no more vain offerings. Incense is an abomination to me; new moons, Sabbaths, and convocations: I can’t stand evil assemblies.
verses.en_bbe: Give me no more false offerings; the smoke of burning flesh is disgusting to me, so are your new moons and Sabbaths and your holy meetings.

verses.en: Your new moons and your appointed feasts my soul hateth: they are a trouble unto me; I am weary to bear them.
verses.pt: Vossas luas novas e vossas solenidades, minha alma as odeia e elas me perturbam; estou cansado de as suportar.
verses.en_web: My soul hates your New Moons and your appointed feasts. They are a burden to me. I am weary of bearing them.
verses.en_bbe: Your new moons and your regular feasts are a grief to my soul: they are a weight in my spirit; I am crushed under them.

verses.en: And when ye spread forth your hands, I will hide mine eyes from you: yea, when ye make many prayers, I will not hear: your hands are full of blood.
verses.pt: Por isso quando estendeis vossas mãos, escondo meus olhos de vós; até quando fazeis muitas orações, eu não vos ouço; porque vossas mãos estão cheias de sangue.
verses.en_web: When you spread out your hands, I will hide my eyes from you. Yes, when you make many prayers, I will not hear. Your hands are full of blood.
verses.en_bbe: And when your hands are stretched out to me, my eyes will be turned away from you: even though you go on making prayers, I will not give ear: your hands are full of blood.

verses.en: Wash you, make you clean; put away the evil of your doings from before mine eyes; cease to do evil;
verses.pt: Lavai-vos! Purificai-vos! Tirai a maldade de vossas atitudes perante meus olhos; parai de fazer maldades.
verses.en_web: Wash yourselves, make yourself clean. Put away the evil of your doings from before my eyes. Cease to do evil.
verses.en_bbe: Be washed, make yourselves clean; put away the evil of your doings from before my eyes; let there be an end of sinning;

verses.en: Learn to do well; seek judgment, relieve the oppressed, judge the fatherless, plead for the widow.
verses.pt: Aprendei a fazer o bem; procurai o que é justo; ajudai ao oprimido; fazei justiça ao órfão; defendei a causa da viúva.
verses.en_web: Learn to do well. Seek justice. Relieve the oppressed. Judge the fatherless. Plead for the widow.”
verses.en_bbe: Take pleasure in well-doing; let your ways be upright, keep down the cruel, give a right decision for the child who has no father, see to the cause of the widow.

verses.en: Come now, and let us reason together, saith the LORD: though your sins be as scarlet, they shall be as white as snow; though they be red like crimson, they shall be as wool.
verses.pt: Vinde, então, e façamos as contas,diz o SENHOR: ainda que vossos pecados sejam como a escarlate, eles ficarão brancos como a neve; ainda que sejam vermelhos como o carmesim, eles se tornarão como a lã.
verses.en_web: “Come now, and let us reason together,” says Yahweh: “Though your sins be as scarlet, they shall be as white as snow. Though they be red like crimson, they shall be as wool.
verses.en_bbe: Come now, and let us have an argument together, says the Lord: how may your sins which are red like blood be white as snow? how may their dark purple seem like wool?

verses.en: If ye be willing and obedient, ye shall eat the good of the land:
verses.pt: Se quiserdes e ouvirdes, comereis o que é bom da terra.
verses.en_web: If you are willing and obedient, you shall eat the good of the land;
verses.en_bbe: If you will give ear to my word and do it, the good things of the land will be yours;

verses.en: But if ye refuse and rebel, ye shall be devoured with the sword: for the mouth of the LORD hath spoken it.
verses.pt: Porém se recusardes e fordes rebeldes, sereis devorados pela espada;pois foi assim que a boca do SENHOR falou.
verses.en_web: but if you refuse and rebel, you shall be devoured with the sword; for the mouth of Yahweh has spoken it.”
verses.en_bbe: But if your hearts are turned against me, I will send destruction on you by the sword; so the Lord has said.

verses.en: How is the faithful city become an harlot! it was full of judgment; righteousness lodged in it; but now murderers.
verses.pt: Como a cidade fiel se tornou uma prostituta! Ela estava cheia de juízo, justiça habitava nela; porém agora homicidas.
verses.en_web: How the faithful city has become a prostitute! She was full of justice; righteousness lodged in her, but now murderers.
verses.en_bbe: The upright town has become untrue; there was a time when her judges gave right decisions, when righteousness had a resting-place in her, but now she is full of those who take men's lives.

verses.en: Thy silver is become dross, thy wine mixed with water:
verses.pt: Tua prata se tornou em escórias; teu vinho se misturou com água.
verses.en_web: Your silver has become dross, your wine mixed with water.
verses.en_bbe: Your silver is no longer true metal, your wine is mixed with water.

verses.en: Thy princes are rebellious, and companions of thieves: every one loveth gifts, and followeth after rewards: they judge not the fatherless, neither doth the cause of the widow come unto them.
verses.pt: Teus príncipes são rebeldes, e companheiros de ladrões; cada um deles ama os subornos, e perseguem recompensas; não fazem justiça ao órfão, e não chega perante eles a causa das viúvas.
verses.en_web: Your princes are rebellious, and companions of thieves. Everyone loves bribes, and follows after rewards. They don’t judge the fatherless, neither does the cause of the widow come to them.
verses.en_bbe: Your chiefs have gone against the Lord, they have become friends of thieves; every one of them is looking for profit and going after rewards; they do not give right decisions for the child who has no father, and they do not let the cause of the widow come before them.

verses.en: Therefore saith the Lord, the LORD of hosts, the mighty One of Israel, Ah, I will ease me of mine adversaries, and avenge me of mine enemies:
verses.pt: Por isso diz o Senhor DEUS dos exércitos, o Poderoso de Israel: Ah, tomarei satisfações quanto aos meus adversários, e me vingarei de meus inimigos.
verses.en_web: Therefore the Lord, Yahweh of Armies, the Mighty One of Israel, says: “Ah, I will get relief from my adversaries, and avenge myself on my enemies;
verses.en_bbe: For this reason the Lord, the Lord of armies, the Strong One of Israel, has said, I will put an end to my haters, and send punishment on those who are against me;

verses.en: And I will turn my hand upon thee, and purely purge away thy dross, and take away all thy tin:
verses.pt: E tornarei minha minha mão contra ti, e purificarei por completo tuas escórias; e tirarei toda a tua impureza.
verses.en_web: and I will turn my hand on you, thoroughly purge away your dross, and will take away all your tin.
verses.en_bbe: And my hand will again be on you, washing away what is unclean as with soap, and taking away all your false metal;

verses.en: And I will restore thy judges as at the first, and thy counsellors as at the beginning: afterward thou shalt be called, The city of righteousness, the faithful city.
verses.pt: E restituirei a teus juízes, como da primeira vez, e a teus conselheiros, como no princípio; e depois disso te chamarão cidade da justiça, cidade fiel.
verses.en_web: I will restore your judges as at the first, and your counselors as at the beginning. Afterward you shall be called ‘The city of righteousness, a faithful town.’
verses.en_bbe: And I will give you judges again as at the first, and wise guides as in the past; then you will be named, The Town of Righteousness, the true town.

verses.en: Zion shall be redeemed with judgment, and her converts with righteousness.
verses.pt: Sião será resgatada por meio do juízo; e os que retornarem a ela, por meio da justiça.
verses.en_web: Zion shall be redeemed with justice, and her converts with righteousness.
verses.en_bbe: Upright acts will be the price of Zion's forgiveness, and by righteousness will men be living there.

verses.en: And the destruction of the transgressors and of the sinners shall be together, and they that forsake the LORD shall be consumed.
verses.pt: Mas para os transgressores e pecadores, serão juntamente quebrados; e os que deixarem ao SENHOR serão consumidos.
verses.en_web: But the destruction of transgressors and sinners shall be together, and those who forsake Yahweh shall be consumed.
verses.en_bbe: But a common destruction will overtake sinners and evil-doers together, and those who have gone away from the Lord will be cut off.

verses.en: For they shall be ashamed of the oaks which ye have desired, and ye shall be confounded for the gardens that ye have chosen.
verses.pt: Porque pelos carvalhos que cobiçastes serão confundidos; e pelos bosques que escolhestes sereis envergonhados;
verses.en_web: For they shall be ashamed of the oaks which you have desired, and you shall be confounded for the gardens that you have chosen.
verses.en_bbe: For you will be put to shame because of the trees of your desire, and because of the gardens of your pleasure.

verses.en: For ye shall be as an oak whose leaf fadeth, and as a garden that hath no water.
verses.pt: Porque sereis como o carvalho ao qual suas folhas caem, e como o bosque que não tem água.
verses.en_web: For you shall be as an oak whose leaf fades, and as a garden that has no water.
verses.en_bbe: For you will be like a tree whose leaves have become dry, and like a garden without water.

verses.en: And the strong shall be as tow, and the maker of it as a spark, and they shall both burn together, and none shall quench them.
verses.pt: E o forte se tornará em estopa, e sua obra, em faísca; e ambos serão juntamente queimados, e não haverá quem os apague.
verses.en_web: The strong will be like tinder, and his work like a spark. They will both burn together, and no one will quench them.”
verses.en_bbe: And the strong will be as food for the fire, and his work as a flame; and they will be burned together, with no one to put out the fire.
